meta.adapted_from: The author's own Openship design system, renamed Orbyn.
meta.changes: Gellix replaced by Geist (sans) and JetBrains Mono (mono) for licensing; both are SIL OFL and are loaded as hosted Google Fonts families, with no font files bundled. Every colour, spacing, radius, shadow and size value is unchanged. Product paths, icon catalogue and logo dropped.
